# 🚦 Post-Deployment Verification

## Deployment metadata
- Environment:
- Deployed commit:
- Deployment URL:
- Deployed at:
- Verifier:

## Smoke tests
- [ ] Main page loads over HTTPS
- [ ] Branded favicon loads
- [ ] Styles and fonts load or fall back correctly
- [ ] Send a prompt and receive local reply
- [ ] Empty prompt is rejected
- [ ] Clear conversation works
- [ ] Minimize and expand work
- [ ] Narrow viewport remains usable
- [ ] Browser console has no new errors

## Evidence
Record screenshots, logs, and browser versions without private chat content.

## Outcome
Pass / Fail / Partial. List defects and rollback decision.
